name: TRIAD SOCIETY
original_name: トライアッドソサエティ
source:
Ryuto Sumeragi was a young man without income or job.
He lived off his parents' allowance and was a self-indulgent chauvinist.
But then his cash supply was suddenly cut off.

So Ryuto starts selling weapons at the advice of his sexy maids!
